weekly.title: Itacolomi Park in Minas Gerais Combines Hiking, History and, Now, Overnight Stays
weekly.summary:
Itacolomi State Park, in Ouro Preto, in the interior of Minas Gerais in southeastern Brazil, reopened in February and now offers accommodation in addition to trails and historical heritage. The park is open from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Tuesday through Sunday, and admission costs R$28.75.
